# Ufuq — Your Digital Transformation Partner

> Ufuq (https://ufuq.agency) is a digital agency that builds digital systems, mobile and web applications, AI workflows, Framer websites, and WordPress platforms for ambitious businesses and agencies worldwide.

## Core Services

- **Mobile App Design**: Clean, functional, and delightful iOS & Android mobile application design.
- **Web App Design**: Sleek, responsive, and intuitive web application interfaces and dashboards.
- **Framer Websites**: High-conversion, high-performance landing pages and marketing websites built in Framer.
- **AI Solutions**: Custom AI workflows, integrations, automations, and intelligent product features.
- **WordPress Development**: Fast, editable, manageable WordPress websites with modern component systems.
- **Brand Identity Design**: Distinctive visual identity systems, logos, typography, and design guidelines.

## Process

1. **Week 1 — Map**: Define the offer, pages, content model, conversion paths, and CMS ownership before design starts.
2. **Weeks 2-4 — Build**: Design and build in tight review cycles with reusable components and real content.
3. **Ongoing — Operate**: Team training, comprehensive system documentation, and post-launch performance tuning.

## Communication & Delivery

- Async-first communication via writing, clear preview links, and structured action items without unnecessary meetings.
- Tools: Figma, WordPress, Framer, modern web technologies.
